questionText:
Read the passage carefully and answer the questions based on the
passage:
The background to the SRC is as follows. In the 1920s, the Indian National
Congress was reconstituted on linguistic lines. Its provincial units now
followed the logic of language – one for Marathi speakers, another for
Oriya speakers, etc. At the same time, Gandhi and other leaders promised
their followers that when freedom came, the new nation would be based on
a new set of provinces based on the principle of language. However, when
India was finally freed in 1947, it was also divided. Now, when the
proponents of linguistic states asked for this promise to be redeemed, the
Congress hesitated. Partition was the consequence of intense attachment
to one’s faith; how many more partitions would that other intense loyalty,
language, lead to
 
 
In which year Andhra Pradesh was declared as the first linguistic state?

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
On 1 October 1953, the Telugu-speaking regions of Madras State were separated to form Andhra State, making 1953 the milestone year for linguistic statehood in India.
Hence, option (D) is correct.

questionText:

Statement I: Stage 1 of demographic transition has low population growth because high birth rates are canceled out by high death rates.
Statement II: Stage 2 of demographic transition witnesses zero population growth because death rates equal birth rates.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
